scenario.name: Shackleton Lunar Search & Rescue
scenario.description:
A lander has gone down inside the south-polar search box. Seven surface assets
must find the crash site, keep comms, and report it before the mission clock
expires. The practice model draws on the STP Lunar SAR mission-manager API:
MoveToCoord, Stop, RotateToAzimuth, PickUpAntenna, PlaceDownAntenna, telemetry,
state of charge, comms and target-scan status.

strategies.name: sector-relay
strategies.description: Even sectors, 20% reserve, redeploy ANT-1 to the best relay site.

command: uv run --locked wsorb campaign run --scenario lunar_sar --replicates 24 --seed 42 --strategies all --out runs --notebook --author 'Simulation runner' --title 'Lunar SAR strategy comparison'
